changes.text: 1854年7月，霍乱又回到了伦敦。约翰·斯诺倡导一种关涉供水与霍乱的学说已经五年，这一次他写下的决心很直白：不惜一切力气，弄清供水对疫情进程的确切影响；地点选在“一切条件都如此恰好适合这项调查”的街区；而且要亲自去查，因为他要的是“最令人满意的证明”，来检验这个学说究竟是对还是错。

In July 1854 cholera came back to London. John Snow had been advocating a doctrine bearing on how water supply affected cholera for five years, and this time he wrote down his resolve without ornament. He would "spare no exertion which might be necessary to ascertain the exact effect of the water supply on the progress of the epidemic", in places where "all the circumstances were so happily adapted for the inquiry". And he would do the work himself, because he wanted "the most satisfactory proof of the truth or fallacy of the doctrine which I had been advocating for five years."
他看中的是伦敦南部的一片街区。那里有两家自来水公司，水管各自铺进所有街道，几乎深入每一条巷子和院落；哪栋房子接哪一家，是当年两家公司激烈竞争时由房主或住户定下的。结果，很多房子的水和左右两边的邻居都不一样。斯诺看到的，是一场没有人安排、却已经摆在眼前的对照。难处在于：要把它用起来，就得逐户查清每一栋发生霍乱死亡的房子用的是哪家的水，而很多住户自己也说不清。

What he had in view was a stretch of south London served by two water companies. "The pipes of each Company go down all the streets, and into nearly all the courts and alleys." Which company a house took had been settled by the owner or occupier back "when the Water Companies were in active competition", and, as Snow put it, "In many cases a single house has a supply different from that on either side." Nobody had arranged a comparison, yet one was already laid out in front of him. The difficulty was that using it meant learning, house by house, which company supplied each house where a cholera death occurred, and many residents could not say themselves.
其次，“两组人没有任何差别”是斯诺的断言，不是随机分组的结果。哪栋房子接哪家水，由当年的房主或住户决定，并非抽签；这种选择会不会和房租、房龄、地段有关，本篇的证据无法回答，这是作者提出的疑问。斯诺自己的调查也显示，按周交租的工人家庭，水费一律由房东或其代理人缴纳，住户对用哪家公司的水一无所知。作者认为，“选择”往往不在喝水的人手里。

Second, "no difference whatever" between the groups is Snow's assertion, not the product of random assignment. Which company a house took was decided by the owner or occupier, not drawn by lot; whether that choice tracked rents, the age of the houses or their location is a question the evidence here cannot answer, and it is the author's question. His own inquiry shows that for working families on weekly rents the rates were paid by the landlord or his agent, and the residents did not even know which company supplied them. One reading is that the choice was often not in the hands of the people drinking the water.

dispositions.rationale: 首次提到学说时，中英文都点明它关涉供水与霍乱，依据是斯诺把检验学说与弄清供水对疫情进程的影响连在一起。没有补写学说的具体内容，也没有补写斯诺的履历。

evidence.quote: ascertain the exact effect of the water supply on the progress of the epidemic
the truth or fallacy of the doctrine which I had been advocating for five years

dispositions.rationale: hook.1 末尾中英同步加了一句，说明难点在于要逐户查清死亡房屋的供水，而住户往往自己也说不清；同时在 ev 中补入 W-E6 和 W-E9。story.4 未改动。

evidence.quote: all that was required was to learn the supply of water to each individual house where a fatal attack of cholera might occur
they can seldom remember the name of the Water Company till they have looked for the receipt

dispositions.rationale: 英文删去了“, not Snow's”。证据不能说明斯诺是否讨论过这个问题，删去后英文与中文“这是作者提出的疑问”一致。中文原样保留，按同步规则一并给出全文。
